endpoint: Generation-32 fresh scattered assay, both cues and both output ports strictly above aligned margin 0.25.
phase_order: all new generation-14 boundaries and features
all generation-15-to-32 continuations and terminal assays
primary_estimand: Equal-block average of baseline squared prediction error minus candidate squared prediction error, averaging 64 related history/founder/recipient records within each block.
primary_gate: Both one-sided 95% Student-t lower limits exceed 0.002; a conjunction of two frozen superiority claims. No individual claim of familywise significance is added.
negative_classification: If an upper one-sided 95% limit for either primary gain is below 0.002, the declared practical superiority is unsupported in that comparison; otherwise a failed lower gate is unresolved, not equivalence.
uncertainty_scope: Approximate block-level Student-t inference with independent newly generated blocks, conditional on frozen development training. No finite-sample distribution-free or state-specific probability guarantee.
sample_plan: Fixed 64 blocks from development plug-in 80% planning; uncertainty in the eight-block variance is reported and does not trigger resizing or interim peeking.
frozen_model_training: All 512 exposed development records, fixed grid and choices; no prospective refitting.
full_nonlinear_replay: Separately implemented teaching, damage generation, every rebuild and terminal read for every branch, compared byte for byte before evidence acceptance.
holding_state_contract: Post-capture holding states are discarded in the source. This evaluation simulates and verifies the carried packet and fresh read dynamics, and omits the causally disconnected holding updates. No saved hold-state endpoint is claimed.
numeric_failure_policy: Stop and preserve artifacts on any identity, replay, hash, nonfinite or score audit failure. No automatic restart, replacement, model change or block substitution.
